description: This file defines the interface CustomerAttributeDao, which extends the generic SalesManagerEntityDao to provide data access methods for CustomerAttribute entities, with methods to retrieve attributes based on various options and customer/store identifiers.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for CustomerAttribute entities providing retrieval methods based on options and customer/store identifiers.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on the store, customer ID, and option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes matching the store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes matching the store and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes for a given store and customer ID.
